body: twenty summers ago, before any of it, a 16-year-old taylor swift played yahoo's "who's next?" showcase -- two months ahead of her debut album. mid-song she rewrote one of her own lyrics on the spot to shout out yahoo music. everybody starts somewhere. hers was a low-key industry spotlight most people skipped.
why: X-native version of the Debut origin-story item.
